items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: He had miniature scores that my uncle gave him of everything: Beethoven, Mozart, you name it.

ctx.x: Oh my God. © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-

And when he was a kid, when he was about 16, on Sundays he would sit at the kitchen table with the radio on with these scores. He had miniature scores that my uncle gave him of everything: Beethoven, Mozart, you name it. And he would read the scores, you know, like turning the page and listening, listening, listening.
